Messages.Author: Martin Bruset Solberg
Messages.Body:
"Default bleed and strength for both vampires and allies is 1 (allies used
to default to 0)."

Does this mean that all of the new allies has 1 bleed and 1 strength, or
does this change the old ones too?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It only changes the default.
Any ally whose card text specifies a different number uses that number.
Card text overrides the default, as always.
